name: Cervical and Uterine Pathology: HPV, Carcinoma and Leiomyoma

reference.source: Robbins Basic Pathology 9th Edition (topic map; text rewritten, no verbatim copy)
clinicalPearls: E6 p53, E7 Rb: HPV transforms
reference.pathophysiology: E6 ubiquitinates p53 while E7 frees E2F pushing squamous cells through checkpoints; unopposed estrogen mitoses endometrium into PTEN null clones, and myometrial smooth muscle whorls benignly until mitotic atypia sarcomatises.
additionalDifferentials: HSIL versus ASCUS by colposcopy thresholds
Endometrioid versus serous by PTEN and p53
Leiomyoma versus sarcoma by growth and necrosis
additionalInvestigations: Pap with HPV DNA and colposcopy in postcoital bleed
Pipelle with transvaginal thickness in postmenopausal bleed
Ultrasound with LDH in rapidly growing fibroids
